pages.title: What Are Thrusters?
pages.text: Thrusters are Control Seat peripherals that contribute force and torque thrust ratings. The greater the total rating of all linked thrusters, the more maneuverable the vessel becomes.$(br2)A thruster is not a conventional force block: its physical position and orientation do not matter. Simply install as many as your vessel requires.

The Control Seat automatically assigns a throttle level to every thruster. Fuel consumption is proportional to throttle, and no force or torque can be applied when linked fuel tanks contain no valid fuel. See $(l:vsie:control_seat/flying_control)Control Seat: Flight Controls/$.$(br2)Right-click a thruster to open its GUI and adjust the percentage of its rating allocated to force and torque. This allows precise handling adjustments without changing its fuel consumption rate.$(br2)The following pages list the formulas and specifications for each thruster.$(br2)If you experience loss of attention, drowsiness, or impaired cognition while reading, please exit immediately.

pages.title: Thrust Rating and Force
pages.text: Let a thruster's maximum thrust rating be T, its GUI force output setting be F%, and its torque output setting be M%.$(br2)The thruster contributes a force rating of T*F%/100 and a torque rating of T*M%/100. The Control Seat adds the force ratings of all linked thrusters into the total force rating, and likewise adds their torque ratings into the total torque rating.

pages.title: Throttle and Fuel
pages.text: Flight input, damping, antigravity, and auto-level all allocate throttle within the vessel's total thrust rating. Approximate physical force from ordinary forward or reverse throttle is: throttle ratio * total force rating * 0.25 * physics tick step. Translation under view lock contributes at 10% equivalent throttle.$(br2)A thruster's base fuel use per tick is: base consumption * current throttle percentage. Actual fluid extraction is also multiplied by the selected fuel's consumption multiplier.

pages.title: Thruster Specifications
pages.text: Basic Thruster: maximum rating 20,000; base fuel consumption 1.$(br2)Medium Thruster: maximum rating 200,000; base fuel consumption 8.$(br2)Large Thruster: maximum rating 1,000,000; base fuel consumption 60.

pages.title: Basic Vector Thruster
pages.text: The Basic Vector Thruster has a maximum rating of 20,000 and base fuel consumption of 1.$(br2)Its nozzle pivots around the mounting direction by up to 30 degrees, giving a more visible response to the attitude and translation demands assigned by the Control Seat.$(br2)It was rather troublesome to implement, but AeroIE is developing more entertaining components like it.
